# Iris UI

Token-driven, cross-framework (React, Vue, SolidJS, Svelte) UI component library.

Frameworks: react, vue, solid, svelte. Import components from `@iris-ui-kit/react` or `@iris-ui-kit/vue` or `@iris-ui-kit/solid` or `@iris-ui-kit/svelte`.

## Architecture
- Layer 0 — Theme System: Design tokens, applyTheme, theme store (CSS variables).
- Layer 1 — Meta Primitives: Low-level, single-purpose building blocks.
- Layer 2 — Composite Components: Higher-level interactive components.
- Layer 3 — Layouts: Structural layout components.
- Layer 4 — System Skeletons: Page / section skeleton scaffolds.
- Behaviors: Orthogonal interaction behaviors (hotkeys, click-outside, drag).
- Plugins: Optional heavy capabilities activated through IrisProvider.

## Data & Resilience Primitives (framework-agnostic, from @iris-ui-kit/core)
- `createDisposableScope` — Lifecycle teardown (destroy, child scopes, error isolation).
- `createEventBus` — Typed pub/sub for cross-plugin and cross-controller communication.
- `createQueryCache` — Async fetch dedup with TTL + stale-while-revalidate (SWR).
- `createCircuitBreaker` — Failure isolation: trips after N failures, resets after cooldown.
- `createRateLimiter` — Token-bucket rate limiting with burst capacity.
- `createResilientFetcher` — Composes cache + circuit breaker + rate limiter into one hardened async fetcher.
- `createOutbox` — Offline-first, durable FIFO mutation queue with at-least-once delivery.
- `createReconnectingSource` — Realtime push transport with exponential-backoff reconnection.
- `createDataSource` — Unified data engine: fetch + paginate + sort + filter + select + mutate. Optionally wraps resilient fetcher and outbox.
- `createResourceController` — Higher-level CRUD list controller (Table/ProTable).

## Plugin Ecosystem (12 plugins)
Install plugins as separate packages; activate via <IrisProvider plugins={[…]}>.
Import components from `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-{name}/{framework}`.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-locale-zh` — Simplified-Chinese (zh-CN) message pack for all Iris UI i18n keys.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-editor` — CodeMirror 6 code editor (SQL/JSON/JS/plain) with inline diff view.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-pro-table` — vxe-table-style CRUD data table with sorting, filtering, inline editing, column resize, and row virtualization.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-charts` — Zero-dependency, token-themed SVG charts: line, area, bar, sparkline.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-form-builder` — Schema-driven form builder — render a validated form from a declarative schema.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-notifications` — Persistent notification center with inbox, unread count, mark-read, dismiss.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-admin` — Admin panel extensions: page layouts, user management widgets.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-calendar` — Calendar widget with month/week views and event display.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-dashboard` — Dashboard grid layouts with draggable cards and responsive breakpoints.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-kanban` — Kanban board with drag-and-drop columns and cards.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-markdown` — Markdown editor (CodeMirror) and rendered preview with syntax highlighting.
- `@iris-ui-kit/plugin-query-builder` — Visual query/filter builder with rule groups, operators, and value inputs.

### behaviors (7)
- IrisClickOutside [react/solid/svelte/vue] — behavior
  Behavior wrapper: fires `onOutside` when a pointerdown happens outside the wrapped child tree. Renders a thin `<span style="display:contents">` to capture the child's bounding box without disrupting layout.

- IrisMovable [react/solid/svelte/vue] — behavior
  Behavior wrapper: makes its child draggable. Position is `transform`-based (no layout thrash). The whole wrapper drags by default; pass `byHandle` and put `data-iris-movable-handle=""` on a descendant (e.g. a title bar) to restrict the drag origin.
  react: props position?, defaultPosition?, onPositionChange?, onDragStart?, onDragEnd?, bounds?, byHandle?, disabled?, children?; events onDragEnd, onDragStart, onPositionChange; slots default; types IrisMovableBounds, IrisMovablePosition, IrisMovableProps

  vue: props position?, defaultPosition?, bounds?, byHandle?, disabled?; events dragEnd, dragStart, update:position; slots default; types IrisMovableBounds, IrisMovablePosition
  quality: 9 props, 3 events
- IrisResizable [react/solid/svelte/vue] — behavior
  Behavior wrapper: makes its child resizable via 8-direction handles. The wrapper itself is `display: inline-block; position: relative` so the child can be ANY element (no need for the child to know it's wrapped). Handles are absolutely positioned over the wrapper's edges.
  react: props size?, defaultSize?, onSizeChange?, onResizeStart?, onResizeEnd?, handles?, minWidth?, minHeight?, maxWidth?, maxHeight?, keepAspect?, disabled?, children?; events onResizeEnd, onResizeStart, onSizeChange; slots default; types IrisResizableHandle, IrisResizableProps, IrisResizableSize
  solid: props size?, defaultSize?, minSize?, maxSize?, handles?, disabled?, onSizeChange?, onResizeEnd?, children?; events onResizeEnd, onSizeChange; slots default; types IrisResizableHandle, IrisResizableProps, IrisResizableSize
  svelte: props size?, defaultSize?, handles?, minWidth?, maxWidth?, minHeight?, maxHeight?, disabled?, onSizeChange?, onResizeStart?, onResizeEnd?, children?; events onResizeEnd, onResizeStart, onSizeChange; slots default; types IrisResizableHandle, IrisResizableSize
  vue: props size?, defaultSize?, handles?, minWidth?, minHeight?, maxWidth?, maxHeight?, keepAspect?, disabled?; events resizeEnd, resizeStart, update:size; slots default; types IrisResizableHandle, IrisResizableSize
  quality: 13 props, 3 events

### other (7)
- IrisAdminBreadcrumb [react/solid/svelte/vue] — layer-4
  Breadcrumb trail for the admin header, driven by a `NavNode[]` ancestor chain. The last crumb is the current page (auto-marked `aria-current` by IrisBreadcrumb); earlier crumbs are clickable and call `onSelect(key, node)`. React port of the Vue `IrisAdminBreadcrumb`.
  react: props trail, showIcon?, hideSingle?, separator?, onSelect?; events onSelect; types IrisAdminBreadcrumbProps
  solid: props trail, showIcon?, hideSingle?, separator?, onSelect?; events onSelect; types IrisAdminBreadcrumbProps
  svelte: props trail, showIcon?, hideSingle?, separator?, onSelect?; events onSelect; types IrisAdminBreadcrumbProps
  vue: props trail, showIcon?, hideSingle?, separator?; events select
  quality: 5 props, 1 events
- IrisAdminLayout [react/solid/svelte/vue] — layer-4
  The CMS / admin shell — a Vben-style, router-agnostic, data-driven layout that composes IrisSidebarLayout + IrisHeaderLayout with the admin nav pieces. One `menus` tree drives the collapsible sidebar nav, the header breadcrumb, and (when a `tabs` store is passed) the multi-tab bar; `activeKey` is the current page. The host owns routing: react to `onSelect` / `onActiveKeyChange` and render the page via the children render-prop (wrap it in keep-alive keyed by `tabs.cacheKey` for Vben-style tab caching).
  react: props menus, activeKey?, defaultActiveKey?, onActiveKeyChange?, collapsed?, defaultCollapsed?, onCollapsedChange?, mode?, appTitle?, tabs?, showTabs?, showBreadcrumb?, stickyHeader?, stickyTabs?, menuAlign?, contentWidth?, contentHeight?, sidebarWidth?, collapsedWidth?, logo?, toolbar?, footer?, onSelect?, children?; events onActiveKeyChange, onCollapsedChange, onSelect; slots footer, toolbar; types IrisAdminLayoutMode, IrisAdminLayoutProps
  solid: props menus, activeKey?, defaultActiveKey?, onActiveKeyChange?, collapsed?, defaultCollapsed?, onCollapsedChange?, mode?, appTitle?, tabs?, showTabs?, showBreadcrumb?, stickyHeader?, stickyTabs?, menuAlign?, contentWidth?, contentHeight?, sidebarWidth?, collapsedWidth?, logo?, toolbar?, footer?, onSelect?, children?; events onActiveKeyChange, onCollapsedChange, onSelect; slots footer, toolbar; types IrisAdminLayoutMode, IrisAdminLayoutProps
  svelte: props menus, activeKey?, defaultActiveKey?, onActiveKeyChange?, collapsed?, defaultCollapsed?, onCollapsedChange?, mode?, appTitle?, tabs?, showTabs?, showBreadcrumb?, stickyHeader?, stickyTabs?, menuAlign?, contentWidth?, contentHeight?, sidebarWidth?, collapsedWidth?, logo?, toolbar?, footer?, onSelect?, children?; events onActiveKeyChange, onCollapsedChange, onSelect; slots default, footer, logo, toolbar; types IrisAdminLayoutMode, IrisAdminLayoutProps

  quality: 24 props, 3 events
- IrisAdminTabs [react/solid/svelte/vue] — layer-4
  Vben-style multi-tab bar over a shared {@link TabsNav} store. Each open page is a closable chip; clicking activates (`onChange`), the × closes, and a trailing actions dropdown runs Refresh / Close / Close-others / Close-all on the active tab. The store owns the tab list + active key; the host watches it to sync routing + keep-alive.
  react: props nav, onChange?, onClose?, onRefresh?, reorderable?, onReorder?; events onChange, onClose, onRefresh, onReorder; types IrisAdminTabsProps
  solid: props nav, onChange?, onClose?, onRefresh?, reorderable?, onReorder?; events onChange, onClose, onRefresh, onReorder; types IrisAdminTabsProps
  svelte: props nav, onChange?, onClose?, onRefresh?, reorderable?, onReorder?; events onChange, onClose, onRefresh, onReorder; types IrisAdminTabsProps
  vue: props nav, reorderable?; events change, close, refresh, reorder
  quality: 6 props, 4 events
- IrisErrorBoundary [react/solid/svelte/vue] — layer-1
  Catches errors thrown while rendering its subtree and switches to a fallback UI instead of crashing the whole React tree. Exposes `reset()` (passed to the fallback) that clears the error and re-attempts rendering the children.
  react: props children?, fallback?, onError?; events onError; slots default, fallback; types IrisErrorBoundaryFallbackProps, IrisErrorBoundaryProps
  solid: props children?, fallback?, onError?; events onError; slots default, fallback; types IrisErrorBoundaryFallbackProps, IrisErrorBoundaryProps
  svelte: props children?, fallback?, onError?; events onError; slots default, fallback
  vue: props fallback?, onError?; events onError; slots default, fallback; types IrisErrorBoundaryFallbackProps, IrisErrorBoundaryProps
  quality: 3 props, 1 events

- IrisNavMenu [react/solid/svelte/vue] — layer-1
  Data-driven nested navigation menu — the sidebar nav of the admin shell. Renders a normalized `NavNode[]` tree as an accordion of expandable branches and selectable leaves; the active leaf and its ancestor branches are highlighted, and the active branch trail auto-expands. Router-agnostic: takes `activeKey`, calls `onSelect(key, node)`; the host owns navigation.
  react: props items, activeKey?, expandedKeys?, defaultExpandedKeys?, collapsed?, orientation?, ariaLabel?, onSelect?, onExpandedKeysChange?; events onExpandedKeysChange, onSelect; types IrisNavMenuProps
  solid: props items, activeKey?, expandedKeys?, defaultExpandedKeys?, collapsed?, orientation?, ariaLabel?, onSelect?, onExpandedKeysChange?; events onExpandedKeysChange, onSelect; types IrisNavMenuProps

  quality: 9 props, 2 events
- IrisProvider [react/solid/svelte/vue] — layer-1
  The single unified entry point. Runs the plugins, applies their additive token layer over the active theme, merges their messages under the user's, and exposes their stores via `PluginStoreContext`. The existing Theme / Skin / I18n providers are composed in around it.
